verdict.rationale: Calendly's docs confirm invitees can cancel and reschedule meetings: webhooks fire whenever invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule (calendly-docs-54, calendly-docs-7). Hosts can also send reschedule requests (calendly-docs-14), and multiple calendars sync for conflict checks (calendly-docs-49, calendly-docs-15). The evidence does not describe the invitee-facing flow from the confirmation itself, any policy enforcement, or how connected calendars are updated after a change. Missing for 10: documented reschedule/cancel links in confirmations, enforceable cancellation/reschedule policies (e.g., minimum notice or cutoffs), explicit evidence that all connected calendars update on reschedule/cancel, independent hands-on corroboration.
